skills.detail:
When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect. After that, spawns Tot Musica at close range.

When Tot Musica is spawned:
A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

While Tot Musica is present:
A long-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect.

Tot Musica will disappear when KO'd.
Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, deals a close-range area attack.

Become temporarily invincible after use.
skills.name: Tot Musica

skills.detail:
Reduces damage received from enemies while the skill button is held down.
Deals a long-range area attack with a chance to inflict Sing-Sing state after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Knocks enemies back if Sing-Sing state couldn't be applied.
Adds the amount of reduced damage received from enemies while the skill is active to the damage dealt to enemies.
However, any damage reduced by Trait effects will not be added.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
